name: smart_assistant_app
install:
bash .cursor/resolve-api-dir.sh ensure_api_repo >/dev/null
flutter pub get
dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
start:
if [ -e /dev/kvm ]; then sudo chgrp kvm /dev/kvm 2>/dev/null || true; sudo chmod g+rw /dev/kvm 2>/dev/null || true; fi
sudo service docker start

terminals.name: emulator
terminals.description: Shared Luna_Test_Lite Android emulator (reuses running instance; KVM preferred, software rendering fallback without KVM).

terminals.name: api
terminals.description: smart_assistant_api stack on http://localhost:8080/healthz (postgres, redis, api via docker compose).
